about.body:
I'm Levi Quilliam, the gardener behind Quilliams Gardening & Landscaping. I help homeowners enjoy clean, healthy, and beautiful outdoor spaces without the physical work or time commitment. Whether you need regular mowing, garden maintenance, landscaping improvements, or a full yard clean-up, I provide dependable, practical care tailored to your property and the way you use it.

I work with homeowners who value their time, comfort, and peace of mind. Some are retirees who want to enjoy the garden without the strain. Others are busy families, holiday-let owners, or landlords who need the outside space to stay presentable without chasing someone every week.

My approach is simple: turn up when I say I will, do the job properly, and leave your garden looking better every time. I use practical methods that suit Cornwall's coastal weather, from clean lawn edges and sensible mowing heights to tidy waste handling and low-maintenance planting choices.

faq.description: Got more questions? Reach out to us using the button below

items.question: How much does a garden makeover cost?
items.answer: A garden tidy-up in Cornwall typically costs from £80 for a half-day job. Larger makeovers including landscaping, gravel installation, and planting range from £1,500 to £2,500 over 2 to 3 days. Final pricing depends on garden size, current condition, and access. Send a few photos for an accurate quote within 24 hours.

items.question: How much does lawn mowing cost?
items.answer: A small front lawn typically costs £20 to £30 per cut. An average-sized garden is around £30 to £50. In Cornwall’s mild coastal climate, lawns grow almost year-round, so most customers book fortnightly cuts from March to October, dropping to monthly over winter. I include edging and a clean finish as standard.

items.question: How long will the work take?
items.answer: A regular lawn mow or garden tidy takes 1 to 3 hours depending on size. Hedge trimming is usually half a day. Full landscaping projects like gravel gardens take 2 to 3 days. I’ll confirm the exact timeline when I quote, and I always aim to complete on schedule.

items.question: Can you work with my existing garden features?
items.answer: Yes, absolutely. If something can be kept or improved I’ll tell you, there’s no unnecessary rip-out. Many of my projects involve reshaping existing beds, working around established plants, or repositioning features to create a better layout. I’ll walk you through what makes sense to keep.

items.question: Do you offer ongoing maintenance?
items.answer: Yes. I offer weekly, fortnightly, and monthly maintenance visits starting from around £60 per visit depending on garden size. Most of my regular clients started with a one-off tidy and liked the result enough to book ongoing care. I’ll recommend a schedule that suits your garden and budget.

items.question: What areas do you cover?
items.answer: I’m based in Trevarrian near Newquay and cover most of Cornwall including Truro, St Austell, Bodmin, Padstow, Perranporth, and St Ives. If you’re unsure whether I reach your area, just ask. I’m usually happy to travel across Cornwall for the right job.
